claim: The same study reports no significant dose-dependent IL-18 elevation or hematological abnormalities for the humanized msIL-10R agonist in cynomolgus monkeys at tested doses up to 100 mg/kg under reported conditions. Bounded preclinical negative result, not proof of human safety.
falsifier: Source data or replication shows relevant IL-18 elevation, cytopenias or related toxicity at the reported exposure.
firstUnsupportedArrow: No specified toxicity signal in tested NHPs -> no clinically important toxicity in humans or chronic dosing.
omissions: Animal sample size/power require audit; no human or chronic-dose evidence.
rivalHypotheses: Study may be underpowered for uncommon toxicity.
Safety window may depend on species or schedule.
whatChanged: Preserves absence of specified toxicity signals separately from general safety claims.
whyNow: Same-day primary paper reports high-dose NHP observations that are easy to overgeneralize.
whatItEnables: A precise safety hypothesis for replication and dose-duration testing.
constraints: Endpoint, dose, duration, detection limit and sample size determine interpretation.
crossDomainOpportunity: Reusable preclinical safety table distinguishing non-detection from proof of absence.
nextBoundedMachineMove: Extract dose, duration, group size, IL-18 and hematology data; preserve detection limits.
